title: Xanwan
description: Xanwan was a dispatcher at the Xanwan Freight kiosk. He was quite surprised to hear from Cassian Andor after Cassian broke out of prison. Cassian wanted to leave a message for his mother, but Xanwan had to inform him that his mother had actually passed away. Xanwan had no love for the Empire and was killed by a Stormtrooper at Maarva Andor's funeral.
